subject: Polyglot localization renewal — options, SOW draft, and SLAs for docs + UI strings
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Kahn <emma.kahn@polyglotpartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Polyglot localization renewal — options, SOW draft, and SLAs for docs + UI strings

Hi Emma —

Hope you’re well. Our current engagement for product docs and UI string localization with Polyglot (SOW expires end of June) is up for renewal. I’m starting collection of options & a recommended path for the procurement committee. Can you please: 

- Confirm pricing for 12- and 24-month terms (include volume tiers for >=500K tokens / quarter)
- Share an updated SOW that includes: API-based string extraction for UI, terminology/glossary management, translation memory commitments, turnaround SLAs for priority vs standard tickets, and post-release bug fixes window
- Confirm whether Polyglot can provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and a standard DPA

Attached: current_scope_doc_v2.pdf (contains recent volumes and sample turnaround requests). Our timeline is tight — procurement needs a recommended option by May 20 to get a PO in time for a July 1 start. Deal id: DL-2026-0489.

If helpful I can set up a 30-minute call this week to walk through the scope.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Partner Ops — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment: current_scope_doc_v2.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Emma Kahn <emma.kahn@polyglotpartners.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sales@polyglotpartners.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polyglot localization renewal — options, SOW draft, and SLAs for docs + UI strings

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the details and the doc — helpful. We’d love to continue supporting Redwood. High level options we have today (summary):

1) 12-month standard: subscription + per-word (or per-token) tiered pricing; includes translation memory, 24-hour priority SLA for critical tickets, weekly glossary sync.
2) 24-month committed: 10% discount on list pricing, faster capacity guarantees for peak releases, 2 business day SLA for standard tickets and 8-hour priority SLA.
3) Quarterly trial extension: 3-month pilot at reduced rate with option to convert; recommended if you want to validate the API integration first.

I’m attaching our pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx and a draft SOW (sow_polyglot_v1.docx) that maps to the scopes you called out (UI string extraction API, TM, glossaries, review workflows, analytics). We can include an explicit data retention and IP clause (we typically limit retention for source strings to 18 months unless you request longer) and we’ll provide our SOC 2 summary and DPA template.

Quick ask: can you confirm expected monthly token volume (or pages) once you’ve finalized your release plan? That will let us firm pricing.

I can do a call tomorrow at 10am PT or Thursday afternoon.

Best,
Emma Kahn
Head of Customer Success, Polyglot Partners
emma.kahn@polyglotpartners.com

---
Attachments: pricing_sheet_v1.xlsx, sow_polyglot_v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Kahn <emma.kahn@polyglotpartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polyglot localization renewal — options, SOW draft, and SLAs for docs + UI strings

Emma —

Thanks. Quick answers/clarifications from our side:
- Expected baseline is ~350K tokens/month but we anticipate spikes up to ~900K in big release months (quarterly). Please show pricing bands that cover this range.
- SOC 2 evidence is required for any contract > $50k ARR; can you send the report or a security attestation?
- For UI strings we need a reliable API integration: automatic extraction, context metadata (screenshots or screen IDs), and a simple back-and-forth for in-context reviews by PMs. Please indicate whether you’ll support screenshot uploads in the integration.

We’d like an initial call to review the SOW and pricing. Tomorrow 10am PT works for me. I’ll schedule a 30-minute meeting and invite Laura and Nikhil.

Also, legal wants the SOW editable (docx) so we can redline.

Thanks —
Marissa

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polyglot localization renewal — options, SOW draft, and SLAs for docs + UI strings

Emma / Marissa —

Thanks for the updated SOW. Legal reviewed and prepared a short redline set. Main items: 

- IP & ownership: we need to confirm that translations remain customer-owned; add clause that Polyglot will not reuse proprietary UI copy in other customers’ corpora without explicit opt-in.
- Data retention: change default retention from 18 months to 12 months for source strings unless we opt-in for longer.
- Security: we need a formal SOC 2 Type II report or a signed attestation; a redacted report is acceptable if provided under NDA.
- Liability cap: remove unconscionably broad clauses and ensure limits align with our standard procurement terms.

I attached the redlines (redlines_localization_sow.docx) — please incorporate and return an updated docx for final legal review.

Given the timeline, procurement is aligned to accept a 12-month term with the pilot-to-convert flow if the redlines are resolved by EOD May 20.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
